docs.title: What is Technical Debt?
docs.text:
Technical debt refers to: - Quick solutions that need refining - Features not yet implemented - Known limitations - Future improvements

This is NOT failure - it's honest reflection on what you'd improve with more time.

docs.title: High Priority
docs.text:
Items that would cause problems in production

  1. [Issue Name]
  2. Location: filename.py line X or module/function
  3. Problem: What's wrong or incomplete?
  4. Impact: Why does this matter?
  5. Solution: How would you fix it?
  6. Effort: Estimated time to fix

Example: 1. Hard-coded file paths - Location: ingestion.py lines 23, 45, 67 - Problem: Paths like /data/file.csv won't work on other systems - Impact: Pipeline fails when deployed to different environments - Solution: Use environment variables or config file - Effort: 2 hours

docs.title: ADR
docs.text:
Context We need to process data from four sources (CSV, JSON, text, Excel) for Newham Public Library. The data has quality issues and needs to be cleaned before it can be used for analysis.

Decision We will use a medallion architecture with three layers:

Bronze - raw data ingested exactly as received Silver - cleaned and validated data Gold - analysis-ready aggregations

Reasons

Bronze Layer will just be the raw imports of the four data sources. Can always revert if issues arise. Silver Layer for cleaning the data so it is standardised and any data quality issues are fixed Gold Layer to be transformed data from silver layer for business ready metrics that can be used for dashboards or business reports Medallion architecture allows for data lineage and visibility on how data moves and transforms along the pipeline If more data sources are required, it can be added into bronze without immediately affecting preexisting silver and gold tables

Consequences

Raw data is always preserved in bronze - we can reprocess if cleaning logic changes Silver is the trust boundary - gold always reads from silver, never bronze Gold metrics dependent on business requirements on what an analyst would like to use to report on, more metrics can be added for more business metrics Data quality issues found and addressed in the silver layer rather than in the reports/gold layer Data stored multiple times in different layers - storage capacity affected More tests/validation required for each layer
